name: denubis-token-estimator
description: Measure AI token/word usage from Claude Code and Codex logs for AI-use disclosures. Reports output tokens (origin-deduplicated, main thread vs subagent fan-out) and human-authored input words (machine wrappers stripped), per project, rolled up from the directory via a .token-estimator mapper, optionally broken down by month. WIP — methodology established and reproducible; external audit pending.
